# FCD v3.3-aligned data export

Our synthetic data, expressed in the model of the **FIFA Connect Data standard v3.3**
(the package distributed as "FDS-v3.3": XSD schemas under `fcd/xsd`, namespace
`http://fifa.com/fc`). The hackathon mandates no data standard — this alignment is our
own interoperability choice, and it is an *alignment*, not a FIFA certification: FIFA's
licence text for the standard reserves implementation to authorised users, and the FCD
schemas themselves are FIFA-copyright material that we do not redistribute.

## Exports (in `docs/fds/`, regenerated by `tools/build_fds_data.py`)
- `featured-match.xml` — the featured Arsenal v Manchester City synthetic fixture
- `premier-league-season.xml` — all 380 simulated Premier League matches
- `wsl-season.xml` — all 132 simulated Women's Super League matches

## Mapping
| Our data | FCD v3.3 | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fixture / simulated match | `Match` (fc:MatchType) | `Status="Played"` — the enum value for a completed match. Never `Officialised`: these are simulations. |
| Score | `Phase/@HomeScore`, `@AwayScore` | The ONLY place the FCD model carries a score. Featured match: true 1H/2H phases from goal minutes. Season matches: a single `2H` phase with the cumulative full-time score — no half-time split is invented. |
| Goal | `MatchEvent EventType="Goal"` | `MatchPhase`, `Minute`, `PlayerFIFAId` (synthetic person ID of the scorer). The one FCD event nature our stream genuinely contains. |
| Club | `Team/@OrganisationFIFAId`, `TeamNature` Home/Away | Synthetic club IDs (below). |
| Competition | `Match/@CompetitionFIFAId` | `SYN0001` Premier League, `SYN0002` WSL. |
| Identifiers | `fc:FIFAIdentifier` | Exactly 7 chars from the standard's restricted alphabet. Ours carry an `SYN` prefix (`SYN1000`…, `SYN4000`…) — synthetic, not real FIFA IDs. |

## Deliberately NOT mapped (and why)
- **Players lineups** — `MatchPlayerType` requires shirt number, captain, goalkeeper and
  starting-lineup flags. Our synthetic model generates none of those; rather than
  fabricate them, `Player` elements are omitted (the schema allows `minOccurs=0`).
- **Cards / substitutions** — FCD has natures for them; our event generator does not
  produce them, so none are emitted.
- **Telemetry events** (passes, tackles, pressure, possession changes, coordinates,
  speeds, xT) — FCD is a registration/competition-administration standard and has no
  event-stream model for these. They remain in our documented JSON
  (`football-universe-overlay/v1`) as an extension layer.
- **Officials, facilities, attendance** — not modelled; omitted, never invented.

## Validation
`tools/validate_fds.py <dir-of-fcd-xsds>` validates all three exports against the
genuine `competition.xsd` types with lxml. All three are **VALID**. The tool documents
two semantics-preserving adaptations (a harness declaring the export roots, and
removing the literal `^`/`$` anchors from the `FIFAIdentifier` pattern in a temp copy —
the XSD regex dialect has no anchors and libxml2 otherwise fails every value).

## Reproducing the validation

The exports were validated against the genuine FCD v3.3 XSDs with `tools/validate_fds.py <dir-of-xsds>`. The XSD package is FIFA-copyright and **not redistributable**, so it is deliberately not in this repo: point the script at your own copy of the FCD v3.3 package. Two semantics-preserving harness adaptations are documented in the script header (a harness schema declaring the export roots with the standard's own types, and literal `^`/`$` anchors stripped from the `FIFAIdentifier` pattern in a temp copy, because the pattern is implicitly anchored).
